name: TOB Sunday School Attendance
description: One row per student per week — the "Sunday Goal" checklist (Sunday Class Attendance / Quiz Attendance / Today's Memory Verse). Marked by a teacher/admin from a weekly roster screen (api/sunday_school_admin.py::mark_attendance), never self-reported by the student. completed_memory_verse is auto-set by truth_of_bible.sunday_school.engine.verify_verse_completion() when that week's verse is Verified for this user — not editable directly by the roster screen. goal_bonus_awarded guards check_sunday_goal() so the "complete all 3" bonus is only ever awarded once per student per week.

fields.label: Completed Memory Verse
fields.description: Auto-set when a TOB Sunday School Verse Completion is Verified for this user + week. Not set directly by the roster screen.
